reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was 200 mg elemental and no oxide on the front plus the QR for the batch report, which is actually what I check for. But I already take magnesium at night at home from a bottle, and I don't need a pocket sachet to carry around.
objection: I'm paying for the travel packaging and the box, not for more magnesium. $29.99 for 30 days is a lot more than my bottle when I'm watching every dollar, and I have no reason to take it away from home.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower price per month, close to what a plain bottle of bisglycinate costs, or a bigger-count pouch or bottle option without the single-serve packaging.
